projects.name: smart hackathon team finder
projects.idea: A web application that intelligently matches students with suitable hackathon teammates based on their skills, interests, and availability, while enabling team formation, task management, and reliability evaluation.
projects.description:
1. Project Description
Smart Hackathon Team Finder is a web application that helps students find suitable teammates for hackathons and technical projects based on their skills, experience, interests, and availability. It enables students to create profiles, discover projects, form balanced teams, manage tasks, and evaluate team members' reliability.
2. Key Features
1. Student Registration: College email registration and secure ID card uploads.
2. Student Profiles: Manage skills, academic year, experience, and interests.
3. Project Management: Create projects and specify required skills and team roles.
4. Smart Team Matching: Recommend suitable teammates based on project requirements.
5. Invitation System: Accept or reject invitations to join teams.
6. Team Balance Analysis: Identify missing skills and roles.
7. Task Management: Assign tasks, set deadlines, and track progress.
8. Team Communication: Enable discussions among team members.
9. Peer Evaluation: Evaluate members based on contribution and collaboration.
10. Reliability Score: Calculate reliability using task completion, punctuality, and peer evaluations.
11. Role-Based Dashboards: Provide separate dashboards for students and team leaders.
projects.problemStatement: Problem Statement: Students often struggle to find suitable teammates for hackathons and technical projects based on skills, experience, and availability, leading to unbalanced teams, poor coordination, and ineffective task management.
projects.technicalApproach:
1. Technical Approach
The project uses the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js) to develop a web application. MongoDB Atlas stores student profiles, projects, teams, and tasks, while Cloudinary securely stores college ID card images. A matching algorithm recommends teammates based on skills, experience, interests, and availability.
2. Proposed Solution
The application provides a centralized platform for students to discover projects, form balanced teams, and collaborate effectively. Team leaders can invite members, assign tasks, and monitor progress, while peer evaluations and reliability scores help assess team members' contributions.
projects.memberResponsibilities:
Responsibilities of 4 Team Members
1. Member 1 – Frontend Development: Design the user interface, registration/login pages, student profiles, and dashboards.
2. Member 2 – Backend & Database: Develop APIs, authentication, MongoDB Atlas integration, and Cloudinary ID card uploads.
3. Member 3 – Matching Algorithm: Implement teammate recommendations, matching scores, and team balance analysis.
4. Member 4 – Team Management & Testing: Develop task management, peer evaluation, reliability scoring, integrate modules, and test the application.
